description: Optimal Charging Infrastructure Design for Battery Electric Buses is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Xuegang (Jeff) Ban, Dan McCabe. A “Readme” file is created for each dataset. Below is the schema of the full repo: beb_chargers data gtfs so_king_cty_sites.csv beb_data.py beb_model.py beb_vis.py evaluation.py queue_lambda_sensitivity.py so_king_county_study.py The data folder contains data files used for the project. so_king_cty_sites.csv gives the names and coordinates of the seven candidate charging sites considered for the case study. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0 1.0. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
